name: Risheek Nawka
title: Creative technologist
summary: Risheek Nawka is a 19-year-old creative technologist applying to the a16z Horowitz Academy founding class. Tagline: "I build things where art and technology meet." Key facts: Founder, Summer; Consulted for Adobe; 7 creative-tech projects shipped; Gap year, building full-time.
tagline: I build things where art and technology meet.

highlights.title: International karate champion (Seisenkai Shitoryu)
highlights.description: Won gold at the 4th International Karate Championship in 2018, competing in Seisenkai Shitoryu.

highlights.title: Founded Summer, a home décor brand
highlights.description: Started Summer to test whether people would buy home décor the way they buy fashion, with strong brand pull. Over ₹16 lakh (roughly $16,000) in sales in under six months from about $60 of initial investment. Drew investor attention.

highlights.title: A reel caught Ghazal Alagh’s attention. I pitched at Elevation Capital, then to her the next day.

stat.label: at Elevation Capital, then to Ghazal Alagh the next day

highlights.description: Started creating content on Instagram (@keeshir) and LinkedIn. A reel caught the attention of Ghazal Alagh. I pitched at Elevation Capital, and the next day I pitched to Ghazal Alagh as well.

highlights.title: 7 creative-tech projects shipped
highlights.description: Small, free, phone-first creative projects (software and hardware), each shipped publicly with a short reel. New ones are added as they ship.

highlights.title: Consulted for Adobe in San Francisco
highlights.description: Invited to San Francisco for a one-time consulting project for Adobe: go-to-market and competitive analysis for Firefly, and how consumers in India use AI in creative workflows.

achievements.title: Platform to test brand ideas with AI
achievements.description: Built a platform that lets brands like mine test designs, ideas and value propositions with AI, without much capex, to see what real customers want.

achievements.title: End-to-end ad automation
achievements.description: Built end-to-end automations that produce ads.

achievements.title: Chewcheer, a pet-care brand
achievements.description: Built Chewcheer, a pet-care brand separate from Summer, to see whether a new kind of dog and pet-care brand could be created. The focus was gut health: a prebiotic formulation that helps dogs digest food better.

achievements.title: Hand-coded Java inventory & meal-ordering system
achievements.description: Built, by hand in Java and without AI, an inventory management system and a morning/lunch ordering system for a local business. It ran from March 2025 to January 2026, until a newer AI-built system replaced it.

achievements.title: UC Berkeley summer session: film and business
achievements.description: Spent a couple of months in the Bay Area for the UC Berkeley summer session, studying film and business. While there I joined build sessions and consulted for Adobe.

achievements.title: Joined the Mesa School of Business accelerator
achievements.description: Joined the Mesa School of Business, a startup accelerator in India, and spent the next stretch building real businesses and products.

achievements.title: Designed and taught a prototyping class
achievements.description: Learned prototyping and design, built a framework around it with mentors, and taught it as a class sanctioned by my accelerator. About 65 people signed up (full capacity), from inside and outside the accelerator.

achievements.title: Youngest at Product Folks Unconference 2025
achievements.description: The youngest attendee at the Product Folks Unconference 2025, a conference for senior leaders. I was one of the only young people invited.

achievements.title: Admitted to a top-30 US university. Visa said no.
achievements.description: Wanted to study film and computer science in America. Got into a top-30 US university and could not go because of visa troubles. So I started building.

achievements.title: Founding vice president, National English Honor Society
achievements.description: Founding vice president of the National English Honor Society (NEHS) chapter at my school, the only one in the country.

achievements.title: Board, Science National Honor Society (first chapter in the country)
achievements.description: On the board of the Science National Honor Society (SNHS) chapter at my school, the first one in the country. An honor society, not a club.

achievements.title: Head of the carbon-neutral project
achievements.description: Led the school's flagship sustainability initiative. Water wastage fell by around 30%, close to 1,100 trees were planted, and other efforts cut the overall carbon footprint by 15% (more as the saplings grow). The work continues towards a carbon-neutral school by 2030.

stat.label: planted; water waste down ~30%, carbon footprint down 15%

achievements.description: Wrote a thesis paper on electric motor propulsion.

achievements.title: Organised and hosted the school's first formal esports tournament
achievements.description: Organised and hosted the first formal esports tournament at my school, with a good number of teams and cash prizes.

achievements.title: Research paper on stand-up comedy
achievements.description: Wrote a research paper on stand-up comedy.

achievements.title: Perfect predicted scores, and the Language and Culture award
achievements.description: Perfect predicted scores in most of my subjects, and the subject award in Language and Culture.

achievements.title: Co-designed lesson plans with teachers
achievements.description: Co-designed multiple lesson plans with my teachers.

achievements.title: Proposed a pet therapy initiative at school
achievements.description: The first person at my school to build a pet therapy proposal. It got approvals, I found a location on a very cramped campus, and worked out where to get the pets and how to get them vaccinated. It stalled on budget: the annual board meeting fell about 8 days before the proposal was final, and a CSR sponsor was hard to find in my senior year.

achievements.title: Musical performances, stage fright beaten
achievements.description: Played in multiple musical performances, overcoming stage fright and a fear of music.

achievements.title: Performed in front of 2,000 people
achievements.description: Performed on stage in front of an audience of 2,000, across theater, dance and performing arts, over several years from 2014 to 2018.

achievements.title: Student council, grade 5 to grade 10
achievements.description: A member of student council from fifth grade until I left the school in tenth grade, serving as Vice President and Prefect, winning elections and being nominated every year.

achievements.title: Robotics: Arduino and microcontroller projects, coded by hand
achievements.description: Built many Arduino and microcontroller projects and coded them by hand, without AI, and represented my school in competitions.

achievements.title: Top positions in national science exams (NSTSE, NSO, IMO)
achievements.description: Placed among the top positions in the National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE), the National Science Olympiad (NSO) and the International Mathematics Olympiad (IMO).

achievements.title: Academic Olympiads
achievements.description: Won a long list of academic Olympiads.
